meta.name: aws-spa-deploy
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user is deploying a React/Vite single-page app to AWS, or mentions Amplify, CDK, or wiring up Lambda + API Gateway for a frontend. Covers Amplify hosting, custom domains, CDK backend (Lambda + API Gateway), SES email, CORS configuration, and environment variables. Skip for non-AWS hosts (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages), pure backend services without an SPA, or server-rendered apps (Next.js SSR on Vercel).

copy.tagline: 把 React 单页应用部署到 AWS 并配置域名和 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把 React 应用部署到 AWS 并配上后端 API。
